To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
Pupils’ engagement in PictoPal was related to teachers’ technology integration, which was related to teachers perceptions of teaching/learning, support and technology-based innovations.

PictoPal was a technology-rich curriculum that was successfully implemented in Dutch kindergartens; teachers with a high technology integration were more likely to have positive attitudes and expectations toward technology-based innovations; teachers with high technology integration were likely to have a developmental approach to emergent literacy; and teachers with a high extent of integration were likely to perceive support in stressful work environments.

a technology-rich curriculum can be implemented in a kindergarten classroom, and that the extent of technology integration within this curriculum is related to teachers’ attitudes and expectations, and to their perceptions about teaching and learning, technology, and technology-based innovations.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how to support teachers in enacting a technology rich curriculum in a way that is meaningful for their students.
the enactment of a technology-rich emergent literacy curriculum.
the enactment of a technology-rich emergent literacy curriculum in the context of a Dutch kindergarten.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the use of PICTO PAL can be recommended as an educational innovation to enhance emergent literacy learning of Dutch kindergartner pupils.

teachers enacting a technology rich curriculum for emergent literate learners can be successful in terms of pupil learning, provided they have a developmental approach to the curriculum and technology and positive perceptions of their own and others’ support.
PictoPal was effective for the development of emergent literacy of senior kindergarteners, but not for the development of junior kindergartener emergent literacy.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the use of PICTOPAL in kindergarten education is effective for enhancing the emergent literacy skills of Dutch pupils.
PictoPal was a technology-rich curriculum that enabled teachers to integrate technology into their classroom practice and to support pupils’ emergent literacy development.

the PictoPal curriculum has a positive effect on emergent literacy and the extent of technology integration within PICTOPAL has a positive effect upon teacher technology integration and perceptions about teaching/ learning, technology and technology based innovations.
The main takeaway from our work is that
teachers’ technology integration is not a sufficient condition for pupils’ learning.
technology integration in the context of PictoPals is related to teachers’ positive attitudes and expectations, and their positive perceptions of support.
technology-based innovations are a powerful resource for teaching/learning, but that the way teachers integrate technology in their curriculum is crucial for successful learning outcomes.
